rate.notes: 'דמי ניהול פיקדון ניירות ערך (לרבות יחידות השתתפות בקרנות נאמנות)': the price cell reads '0.15%, מינימום 270 ₪' and, on the next line, 'לרבעון'; charged 'ביום העסקה' as printed. The tariff does not say whether 0.15% is a quarterly or an annual rate; recorded per quarter as printed, unconfirmed. It prints no exemption of makam or money-market funds; the bank ban (BRK-17) does not apply to a non-bank member (BRK-52). CONFLICT: Meitav Trade's own pages say 'ללא דמי משמרת ועמלות נסתרות' (https://www.meitav.co.il/trade/about/) and 'פטור מדמי משמרת' (https://www.meitav.co.il/trade/independent_trading/, both read 2026-10-26); the tariff, the binding list, is stored.
